compiled_state.description:
## Context

After A2's onboarding wires Strata-aware DSO config, planning skills (`/dso:brainstorm`, `/dso:preplanning`, `/dso:implementation-plan`) still have no SDK awareness. Plans propose intake forms as plain Rails models, miss `strata:application_form` generators, recommend `belongs_to :case` (forbidden by SDK design), invent attribute types the SDK already provides (`:money`, `:tax_id`, `:memorable_date`). This epic delivers tiered facts (concept / decomposition / implementation) auto-regenerated from upstream `strata-sdk-rails` plus per-skill manual guidance, loaded conditionally per epic-level `strata:scoped` tag set by brainstorm. Brainstorm uses concept-level facts in every Strata-detected project to assess SDK fit; sets the tag in its emitted epic spec; preplanning + implementation-plan inherit and load deeper tiers only when scoped. Plan-validation extends existing scrutiny prompts with SDK-aware checklists derived from the decomposition tier — no new sub-agents.

External contracts (consumed):
- A2: `${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/strata-detection.env` with `STRATA_DETECTED=yes|no` + `STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND=rails|nextjs|flask|infra` + `STRATA_COMMIT_PIN` + `STRATA_SRC_PATH` + `STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE=marker|gemfile-fallback`; `dso-config.conf` `strata.skip` key
- A0: `stack=` namespaced array; `commands.*` semicolon-delimited multi-valued
- Upstream `navapbc/strata-sdk-rails` source paths: `lib/generators/strata/**/*.rb`; `app/models/strata/*.rb`; `app/lib/strata/attributes.rb`; `strata.gemspec`; `app/policies/strata/application_form_policy.rb`

## In Scope

- Tiered facts files (auto-regenerated under `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/strata-sdk-facts/`):
  - `concepts.md` (~30 lines): three SDK concepts (ApplicationForm, Case, BusinessProcess) with class doc-comment purposes; four generator names with one-line purposes; two UI surfaces; SDK layer position
  - `decomposition.md` (~60 lines): generator chain rules; base attributes per generator; domain model relationship rules (Case→Form via `application_form_id:uuid`, NOT `belongs_to`); Pundit policy structural requirement
  - `implementation.md` (~120 lines): exact CLI signatures with hyphenated flag spelling (e.g., `--application-form` not `--application_form`); Strata attribute type registry; file path conventions per generator; class hierarchy; gem dependencies + Rails version compatibility
  - `README.md`: index documenting which file is loaded by which skill at which abstraction tier
- Per-skill manual guidance (under `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/strata-sdk-guidance/`):
  - `brainstorm.md` (~30 lines): when-to-use Strata SDK vs. plain Rails; common epic shapes for SDK; capability-verification heuristics
  - `preplanning.md` (~30 lines): story-decomposition heuristics for SDK chains; E2E nudge for Strata-scoped epics ensuring acceptance criterion exercises SDK call sequence; multi-concept reconciliation checklist for red-team
  - `implementation-plan.md` (~30 lines): pitfall WHYs (ActionController::API hook mechanics; Case-Form FK rationale; generator chain semantics; underscored-flag silent-ignore); SDK test helper exemplars (~15 lines: signature table only — `fill_address`, `choose_yes`, `fill_ssn`, `fill_date`, `click_next`, `start_next_task`, `wait_for_conditional` — citing lockpick as implementation source, marked exemplars not canonical)
- Per-skill conditional loading:
  - `/dso:brainstorm` — gated by A2's project-level detection (STRATA_DETECTED=yes + STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND=rails + strata.skip != true). When gated open, Reads `concepts.md` + `guidance/brainstorm.md` at Phase 1 Step 1 (~60 lines). During Phase 1 Gate Step 2, if `STRATA_UNCERTAINTY` binary signal fires (capability-verification cannot be answered from concepts.md alone), on-demand Reads `decomposition.md` for deeper structural verification. At Phase 2 Step 2, brainstorm sets `strata:scoped` tag on epic based on its structural fit assessment. Tag UX disclosure: brainstorm emits visible inline message on tag set/unset with override path. Tag lifecycle symmetric (set + unset paths supported via brainstorm re-runs)
  - `/dso:preplanning` — gated by epic's `strata:scoped` tag. Tag-scoped read (bound to specific epic-id, not global). When gated open, Reads `concepts.md` + `decomposition.md` + `guidance/preplanning.md` at appropriate phases (~120 lines). Read-after-write fence: preplanning's first action verifies tag present with retry + escalation
  - `/dso:implementation-plan` — gated by epic's `strata:scoped` tag (inherited via story → epic chain). When gated open, Reads all three facts + `guidance/implementation-plan.md` (~240 lines)
- Plan-validation extension (no new sub-agents): existing scrutiny prompts (preplanning red-team / blue-team / phase-e-adversarial-review; implementation-plan gap-analysis) gain conditional Strata-violation checklist sections that load when Strata context is present. Conditional sections OMITTED (not empty blocks) when epic lacks `strata:scoped`. Section header named "REQUIRED when strata:scoped tag present", positioned EARLY in prompt. Checklist content data-driven from `decomposition.md` structural-rules section. Validation checks: plan uses SDK generators; Case→Form via `application_form_id:uuid`; Pundit policy required; generator flags hyphenated; chained generators not double-invoked; multi-concept consistency
- Regeneration tool (`plugins/dso/scripts/regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh`): pinned to specific upstream `strata-sdk-rails` tag/commit recorded in `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/strata-template-vars.sh`. Reads SDK source via `gh api` at pinned ref. Parses generators (class_option/argument declarations + invoke calls), attribute types (Strata::Attributes module includes), class hierarchy, gem dependencies, route definitions, class doc-comments into structured intermediate (JSON). Renders three views from intermediate. Each output gets `# AUTOGENERATED — do not hand-edit; regenerate via plugins/dso/scripts/regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh` header + `# strata-sdk-facts-schema-version: 1` + `# pinned-sdk-ref: <tag-or-commit>` + completeness flag (`# completeness: full | partial-conditional-chain-<N> | partial-runtime-types-<N>`). Documents 5 spike-identified caveats inline (conditional generator chains as `[optional]`; Pundit-as-mixin not auto-generated per model; Determination's hardcoded paths exception; Rails 8 compat pending; runtime-registered attribute types not in registry)
- Manual-residual handling via `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/strata-sdk-facts/manual-residual-index.json`: schema `{ topic_id: string (unique key), content: string (markdown fragment), last_modified: ISO 8601 timestamp }`. Regeneration script reads index, regenerates auto sections, splices manual content via deterministic key-lookup. LLMs never preserve markers because there ARE no markers in auto-generated content. Manual-residual-index.json hand-edits permitted (not gated by CI fresh-check)
- 5 behavioral guarantees with observable failure modes:
  - Atomicity: facts file writes + manual-residual restoration are atomic. Concurrent reader sees partial-content facts file → guarantee violated
  - Drift-detection correctness: weekly CI cron runs regeneration against latest upstream HEAD; substantive structural diffs trigger advisory PR. Substantive upstream change without advisory PR within 7 days → guarantee violated
  - Fail-open-on-load: missing/malformed facts files do not block planning skills; emit clear `[B] facts unavailable; running without Strata context` warning; fall back to non-Strata behavior. Missing facts file blocks a planning skill → guarantee violated
  - Tag-scoped-read: planning skills read `strata:scoped` tag bound to specific epic-id, never global. Planning skill loads facts when target epic lacks tag → guarantee violated
  - Cross-skill-consistency: brainstorm tag write completes before exit; preplanning verifies tag presence before loading. Brainstorm completes setting tag; preplanning's first action sees tag absent → guarantee violated
- Single shared facts load for parallel reviewers: orchestrator loads facts ONCE and passes content to each scrutiny reviewer; reviewers do NOT re-Read facts files
- STRATA_SKIP early evaluation: each planning skill checks `strata.skip` BEFORE any Strata Read or sub-agent dispatch. Sub-agents inherit a `STRATA_SKIP=true` env var when set. STRATA_SKIP fail-open: when signal absent (A2 not yet merged or renamed), gating treats absence as `STRATA_SKIP=false` (proceed with detection)
- Spike-baseline artifact at `tests/audits/B-feasibility-spike-results.md` (PRE-SPRINT GATE): captures both 2026-05-07 concepts spike + 2026-05-08 decomposition+implementation spike findings, sample extractions for `strata:application_form`, the 5 documented caveats. Pre-sprint gate behavioral test at `tests/scripts/test-b-pre-sprint-gate.sh` exercises gate against fixture with/without spike artifact
- Two non-blocking upstream tickets filed against `navapbc/strata-sdk-rails` (tracked via story task done-definitions on regeneration-tool story, NOT SC): add `desc` declarations for `strata:case` + `strata:business_process` generators; add applicant-UI-surface concept statement in upstream docs

## Out of Scope

- NextJS/Flask SDK planning context (Rails-only v1)
- DSL emission/transpilation (deferred to placeholder epic 8d1f-5306-7f91-4342)
- Idempotent task semantics (deferred to placeholder epic 85cb-734a-d1c2-449f)
- Mandatory TDD enforcement for SDK code (rejected — DSO's existing testing_mode discipline)
- Customer-specific patterns (NJ-UI from lockpick)
- Auto-update of pinned `strata-sdk-rails` ref in CI (manual ref bumps for v1)
- Sample-feature scaffolding from onboarding
- Modifications to existing scrutiny sub-agent infrastructure

## Success Criteria

1. Tiered facts produced from upstream + atomic + drift-detection correctness verified. Three facts files match golden-master at all tiers; atomic write (mktemp+mv); CI fresh-check against last-committed HEAD baseline fails on hand-edits to AUTO-generated sections (with clear `[B] strata-sdk-facts hand-edit at <file>:<line>; regenerate via plugins/dso/scripts/regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh` error). Weekly drift CI cron correctly distinguishes substantive structural change from whitespace-only diffs via unit test (synthetic diff fixtures with one substantive change + one whitespace-only change; tool opens PR for substantive only); advisory PR includes structured diff summary (not just title).

2. Per-skill conditional load + content correctness + STRATA_SKIP fail-open. Behavioral tests verify: non-Strata project (zero strata-sdk-* Reads); Strata Rails project + brainstorm at Phase 1 Step 1 (Reads concepts + brainstorm-guidance only ≤80 lines AND content assertion: includes SDK terminology like `strata:application_form`, `strata:scoped`); during Phase 1 Gate Step 2 capability uncertainty, on-demand Reads `decomposition.md`; Strata project + epic with `strata:scoped` tag + preplanning (Reads concepts + decomposition + preplanning-guidance); Strata project + epic without tag + preplanning (zero SDK Reads — tag scoped to epic-id); `strata.skip=true` config (zero SDK Reads regardless of detection or epic flag); STRATA_SKIP absent treated as false (fail-open); implementation-plan inherits tag via story → epic chain; STRATA_SKIP env var inherited by sub-agents.

3. Brainstorm sets/unsets `strata:scoped` correctly with tag UX disclosure + read-after-write fence. Tag set across "intake form for SNAP applicants" (yes), "deployment pipeline for Strata project" (no); tag unset across re-runs that determine SDK fit no longer applicable; one-line UX disclosure printed on set/unset; correction path documented. Token-count assertion ≤80 lines from `strata-sdk-facts/` at brainstorm Phase 1 Step 1. Read-after-write fence: brainstorm waits for tickets-branch commit before exit; preplanning's first action verifies tag present with retry + escalation `[B] strata:scoped tag not present on <epic-id>; retry brainstorm`. Dialog-content assertion: when input maps to Strata SDK domain (intake forms, case management workflows, business process orchestration, eligibility determination), Strata-applicable brainstorm output offers SDK-shaped approach alongside non-SDK alternative.

4. Plan-validation extension catches representative SDK footguns + scrutiny prompt isolation preserves non-Strata baseline + parallel reviewers shared facts load. Bad-fixture plan with 4 footguns (`belongs_to :case`, double-chained generators, underscored flags, missing Pundit) produces ≥4 findings citing `decomposition.md` rules. Behavioral test asserts non-Strata epic produces byte-identical scrutiny output (`diff` against `tests/fixtures/scrutiny-non-strata-baseline.txt` exits 0 — no spurious conditional injection). Parallel reviewers receive shared facts content from orchestrator (verified by no duplicate Read in their tool-use logs).

5. Regeneration tool round-trip + manual-residual-index.json integrity. Idempotent re-run produces zero diffs in any facts file; `manual-residual-index.json` round-trip test (add topic_id → run regeneration → entry preserved AND content correctly spliced into regenerated facts file); hand-edits to AUTO-generated sections detected by CI fresh-check (against HEAD baseline) with clear error; manual-residual-index.json hand-edits permitted (not gated).

6. Implementation-plan task output references SDK commands. Behavioral test on Strata-scoped task input (e.g., "scaffold intake form for SnapApp") asserts generated task references SDK generator command invocation (e.g., `strata:application_form` with hyphenated flags `--application-form` not `--application_form`) — not equivalent manual Rails steps. Closes the implementation-plan user-impact validation gap.

## Scenario Analysis

16 surviving scenarios from red/blue team filter (5 filtered). Mitigations folded into Robustness contract: atomic regeneration writes (mktemp + mv); marker validation pre-extraction (well-formed + non-overlapping; replaced with manual-residual-index.json per bot-psychologist HIGH-RISK mandate); decomposition lazy-load size cap (≤80 lines) + uncertainty-binary-signal gating; compaction-resume marker via ticket comment when on-demand load triggers; caveat annotations inline in regenerated facts (Determination paths, Pundit-as-mixin); CI fresh-check against last-committed HEAD baseline; manual guidance staleness advisory on decomposition.md hash change; tag-scoped read; read-after-write fence; single shared facts load for parallel reviewers; STRATA_SKIP early evaluation + env var inheritance; completeness flag in facts header; weekly SDK drift detection (advisory PR on substantive upstream change vs. pinned ref).

## Approach

Tiered auto-regenerated facts (concept / decomposition / implementation) plus per-skill manual guidance (3 files), with `manual-residual-index.json` script-managed (not LLM-preserved markers). Conditional load via epic-level `strata:scoped` tag set by brainstorm based on structural fit assessment using concept-level facts. LLM-based plan validation against decomposition.md (no DSL emission — deferred to placeholder epic 8d1f-5306). Five behavioral guarantees with observable failure modes; implementation details in tasks.

## Dependencies

Blocking on A0 (188c-47e4-5abe-4b9c — namespaced array schema + multi-valued `commands.*`) and A2 (8623-8d6a-0bc1-4c6e — detection artifact + STRATA_SKIP signal + tag mechanism). NO blocking on A1 (B works on any Strata Rails project regardless of how scaffolded). NO blocking on 136b-6758 (B uses existing prompt infrastructure). Pre-sprint gate: `tests/audits/B-feasibility-spike-results.md` present in HEAD AND A0+A2 PRs MERGED before B's first story enters sprint. Verified by `tests/scripts/test-b-pre-sprint-gate.sh`. Two non-blocking upstream tickets filed against `navapbc/strata-sdk-rails` tracked as story task done-definitions on regeneration-tool story.
